boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-purchase ways for UO students to explore campus and Eugene together, using self-guided routes and explicitly free student activities.

cards.title: Browse the JSMA galleries
cards.subtitle: Jordan Schnitzer Museum of Art · UO campus
cards.notes: Bring a friend and wander the galleries at your own pace; college-student admission is listed as free. Check the museum page for closures.
cards.short_summary: A free art-gallery outing for UO and other college students.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum lists admission as FREE for University of Oregon and all college students.
cards.source_title: Hours & Admission | Jordan Schnitzer Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: Closed Mondays and Tuesdays; current museum hours and closure notices are posted on the source page.

cards.title: Follow the Campus Artworks tour
cards.subtitle: Self-guided campus route · UO campus
cards.notes: Open the UOregon app’s Tours section or the linked guide, then take the route together and pause at works that catch your attention.
cards.short_summary: A self-directed walk through named campus artworks.
cards.evidence_claim: UO lists Campus Artworks as one of its self-guided campus tours and says these tours are available in the UOregon app.
cards.source_title: Self-guided Campus Tours | Campus Planning & Facilities Management
cards.access_notes: Use the self-guided materials or UOregon app; stay on publicly accessible campus paths.

cards.title: Join Wednesday trivia at the EMU
cards.subtitle: Erb Memorial Union O Desk · UO campus
cards.notes: Bring a small team or join one on arrival for the recurring Wednesday rounds. The university calendar identifies the activity as free with UO ID.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, free-with-UO-ID team trivia activity.
cards.evidence_claim: UO’s event listing says Trivia in the EMU is FREE every Wednesday and lists the cost as free with UO ID.
cards.source_title: Trivia in the EMU - University of Oregon
cards.access_notes: Recurring Wednesdays at the EMU O Desk; verify the current calendar listing before going.
